leads.snippet: About Augment Logistics is broken. Let's fix it. We are a team of engineers, product designers, and customer champions building Augie, Augment's AI teammate for supply chain. Augie reasons and acts like a seasoned operator, automating the busywork of quoting, dispatch, tracking, billing, and more for freight brokers, 3PLs, for-hire carriers, private fleets, and distributors. Our team has scaled billion-dollar companies, built delightful products, and powered billions in commerce. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and want to define how AI reshapes supply chain, apply today.
